text.en:
1. (1) These regulations may be cited as the Consumer Protection (Safety
Standards for Toys) (Amendment) Regulations 2016.

  (2) These Regulations come into operation on 1 January 2018.

Substitution of First Schedule
text.ms:
1. (1) Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan
Pelindungan Pengguna (Standard Keselamatan bagi Mainan) (Pindaan) 2016.

 (2) Peraturan-Peraturan ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 1 Januari 2018.

text.en:
3. The Second Schedule to the principal Regulations is amended—

(a) by deleting item 2;

(b) in item 3, by substituting for  the words "Home and  public p layground
equipment" the words "Public playground equipment";

(c) in the national language text, in item 19, by substituting for the word "mainan"
the word "bayi"; and

(d) in item 22, by inserting after the words "pri marily of play value" the words
"and not intended for children under fourteen years of age".

Savings

4. (1) Any toy which—

  (a) has complied with the safety standards prescribed under the principal
   Regulations; and

  (b) has been supplied for sale in the market,

before the commencement of these Regulations shall be dealt with as if the principal
Regulations had not been amended by these Regulations.

 (2) Any goods which─

  (a) is not regarded as a toy under the principal Regulations; and

  (b) has been supplied for sale in the market,

before the commencement of these Regulations shall be dealt with as if the principal
Regulations had not been amended by these Regulations.

Made 23 September 2016
[KPDNKK 700-1/2/5; PN(PU2)607/IV]

DATO' SERI HAMZAH BIN ZAINUDIN
Minister of Domestic Trade,
Co-operatives and Consumerism
